verdict.rationale: Grafana's own storage layer lets users decide where telemetry physically resides. Loki stores log chunks in S3, GCS or the local filesystem and can run as a single binary with a local filesystem backend. Grafana OSS queries data wherever it is stored, and a community user confirms self-hosting Loki specifically for privacy. However, there is no evidence of choosing a region or residency location for Grafana Cloud's hosted data, which is the core of a region/residency story for the SaaS offering. missing for 10: documented Grafana Cloud region/data-residency selection, residency/compliance guarantees, independent corroboration of residency controls.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Log data itself is then compressed and stored in chunks in object stores such as Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) or Google Cloud Storage (GCS), or even locally on the filesystem.
